characters.name: 沈澜

visual_features.face: 圆脸，眼尾微垂，笑容停住时嘴角发紧
visual_features.hair: 黑发扎低马尾，碎发贴在耳边
visual_features.body: 围裙系得很紧，端汤时手背有烫红痕

characters.wardrobe_default: 浅绿色围裙 + 白色家居衬衣
characters.visual_signature: 围裙口袋上缝着一枚白色小纽扣
characters.prompt_template_sd: 27-year-old Chinese woman, round face, slightly downturned eyes, low ponytail, light green apron with a small white button on pocket, white home shirt, red mark on back of hand, kitchen doorway, smile stopping

rules.color_temperature: 浅绿白色家务感 vs 深紫金色长辈权威
rules.camera_height: 门口持物站立 vs 沙发中央坐姿
rules.frame_position: 画面左下被挤压 vs 画面中央占满

characters.name: 周淑芬

visual_features.face: 颧骨高，唇线薄，眼神从上往下扫
visual_features.body: 背挺直坐在沙发中央，手指慢慢拨佛珠

characters.wardrobe_default: 深紫旗袍 + 金色披肩
characters.visual_signature: 一串深棕佛珠绕在右手腕
characters.prompt_template_sd: 55-year-old Chinese woman, high cheekbones, thin lips, tight coiled hair, deep purple qipao, golden shawl, dark brown prayer beads around right wrist, sitting centered on sofa, downward judging gaze

rules.color_temperature: 深紫金色长辈权威 vs 浅绿白色家务感
